Angel Lopez · Fresh Air Rainbow® Vacuum – Hopewell Junction
About Angel Lopez

Meet Angel Lopez.

Angel Lopez, the owner of Fresh Air Rainbow® Vacuum – Hopewell Junction, was born in the Dominican Republic in 1970 and came to the United States in 1974. He is one of nine children and learned the intricacies of business from his father, Marino Lopez, who purchased a Spanish deli in 1980 when Angel was 10 years old.

“Take care of your customers and the customers will take care of you.”

In 1990, his father wanted to retire and sold the deli. Angel was 20 years old. Around that time, while looking for a job, he came upon an amazing product called the Rainbow® Vacuum, manufactured by Rexair. With no prior sales experience, he saw the potential in the Rainbow® Cleaning System because of its high quality and uniqueness among other cleaning systems. He thought, “Everyone has to clean, whether we pay someone to help us or do it ourselves. This sells itself!”

The wonderful thing about the Rainbow® Cleaning System is that it was designed and engineered with health in mind, so it makes any home healthier and cleaner while protecting and preserving everything we enjoy in our homes. Angel worked his way up through the company and opened his first office in 1994. The business moved to its current location in 1998, where it has been ever since.

He has built a loyal following of customers by providing a high-quality service and product to the marketplace, always remembering what his father taught him: if we take care of our customers, our customers will take care of us.

Now in his 36th year with Rexair Rainbow® Cleaning Systems, Angel says the secret to his success is simple: he shows people how they can have a clean and healthy home, and lets them decide which products they prefer to use.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What happens during a demonstration?

Angel shows you the Rainbow Cleaning System in person, demonstrates how it works, and answers your questions.

Is the demonstration free?

Yes. Demonstrations are offered free of charge, with no obligation.

How do I schedule an appointment?

Use the form on this page, call +1 845-765-1777, or email alopez.freshair@gmail.com. Angel will contact you to arrange a time. Appointments are confirmed only by Angel.

How long does a demonstration take?

Angel will go over timing with you when you arrange your appointment, so you can choose a time that fits your schedule.

What should I expect afterward?

There is no pressure. Angel will answer any follow-up questions, and you decide what is right for your household.

How can I contact Angel Lopez?

Call +1 845-765-1777 or email alopez.freshair@gmail.com.
